hardware: dedicated 8-vCPU Intel Xeon Platinum 8358 / 32 GiB Linux host
order: all fresh runs, then all adaptive reuse runs; not interleaved
repetitions: one cold plus two warm repeats for each workload; same generation, reset ledger fixture
warm_definition: public c1 cache retained per workload, new private secrets every batch; public filters downloaded on each replay
timing_limit: each process rebuilds server preprocessing and public decoding data; caching is payload accounting, not a warm-runtime benchmark
integration: four independent public matrix slots, maximum one new query per slot per secret, fresh batch on restart
dependencies: exact uncommitted sibling source preserved in ipir-source.tar.gz and source-manifest.json
final_policy: reuse only when key savings exceed missing public c1 bytes; single-query and short cold-page stages remain fresh
